papers.title: The Influence of Heat Input on Microstructure Properties of Wire Arc Additively Manufactured TI-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: Abstract Titanium and its alloys are widely used in aerospace applications where weight is a critical constraint and high strength is essential. The aerospace components manufactured through conventional route is not productive due to the higher cost and long manufacturing process. Wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM) process is one of the prominent methods to produce the reliable components through additive techniques without wastage of materials and saving a lot of time for manufacturing. Using WAAM it is easy to obtain the large-scale components with near net shape. The quality of the deposition and components are related to the process control parameters. The present study is aimed to study the feasibility of applying WAAM method to produce the components with the required properties. In addition, the influence of heat input on microstructural properties and grain size is also studied. The results of the tests revealed that the heat input can be used to control the grain structure during the WAAM. The prior-β grain morphology and anisotropic tensile strength were examined according to the heat input. At lower heat input, the deposits are consisting of mixture prior-β grains (equiaxed and columnar) presented a shape in the middle of the microstructure or the thickness. Whereas at the high heat input deposits, the deposits were consisting of an anisotropic property and the larger columnar grains. The variable of the process parameters assisted with controlling of heat input and the microstructural features are also discussed in details for the WAAM process.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了线弧增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的热输入对微观结构和拉伸性能的影响，但未涉及疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on tensile properties and microstructure control via heat input in WAAM, but does not provide fatigue characterization or S-N data, which are central to the evaluation focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索WAAM工艺参数对Ti-6Al-4V合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变热输入参数，研究WAAM沉积Ti-6Al-4V的微观组织演变和拉伸性能。
summary_zh.result: 低热输入下形成混合等轴和柱状晶粒，高热输入下产生各向异性和粗大柱状晶粒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微组织观察验证热输入对性能的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of using wire arc additive manufacturing for Ti-6Al-4V components and to understand how heat input controls microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: WAAM Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated with varying heat inputs, followed by microstructural analysis and tensile testing to correlate process parameters with property evolution.
summary_en.result: Lower heat input led to a mixture of equiaxed and columnar prior-β grains, while higher heat input promoted anisotropic, coarse columnar grains.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed through tensile tests and metallographic examination of grain morphology.

papers.title: Micro-Wire-EDM Machinability and Surface Study of the New Generation TNZT (Ti-35Nb-7Zr-5Ta) Alloy
papers.abstract: Abstract Previously, titanium grade-V (Ti-6Al-4V) was considered the best biomedical, automotive, and aerospace alloy. However, researchers identified Aluminum and Vanadium toxicity in Ti-6Al-4V; moreover, it possesses a higher Young’s modulus than the new generation titanium (TNZT) alloys. Even though TNZT alloys offer lower modulus and good corrosion properties, the micromachining of these alloys with conventional methods remains a significant challenge. This study presents an experimental analysis of the μ-WEDM machinability of the Ti-35Nb-7Zr-5Ta alloy with tungsten wire of 50 μm diameter. μ-WEDM is a machining process that erodes the material from a workpiece, being electrically conductive, irrespective of its hardness. To evaluate machinability, the quality of the micro-features is assessed based on CA, KF, SR, and MH. The findings revealed that the micro-features on Ti-35Nb-7Zr-5Ta are slightly inferior at higher machining conditions, primarily due to significantly higher capacitance leading to larger spark width, increasing the size of the crater formation and surface hardness. In contrast, smoother surface finishes are achieved at lower machining conditions. At lower machining conditions, the CA, KF, SR, and MH are recorded as 18.9 μm2, 93.3 μm, 0.5 μm, and 310 HV, respectively. Furthermore, the optimal parameters are figured out by using grey relation grade (GRG) analysis post experimentation, the GRG analysis suggested that the lower capacitance (1nF) and voltage (80V) to be the optimal input parameters, and the parameters setting with higher capacitance and voltage 105 V to be the least optimal.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是TNZT合金的微线切割加工性，而非Ti-6Al-4V合金的后处理，与用户关注方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not study Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on a TNZT alloy, and the machining post-processing is not applied to AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: TNZT合金因低模量和良好耐腐蚀性而有望替代Ti-6Al-4V，但其微加工具有挑战性。
summary_zh.method: 采用直径50μm钨丝进行μ-WEDM实验，研究加工参数对表面质量的影响。
summary_zh.result: 低电容和低电压下获得更好表面质量，最优参数为1nF和80V。
summary_zh.validation: 通过灰色关联分析验证参数优化结果。

summary_en.motivation: TNZT alloys are potential substitutes for Ti-6Al-4V due to lower modulus and good corrosion resistance, but their micromachining remains challenging.
summary_en.method: Experimental μ-WEDM with 50 μm tungsten wire was used to evaluate machinability through crater area, kerf width, surface roughness, and microhardness.
summary_en.result: Lower capacitance and voltage yielded better surface quality; optimal parameters were 1 nF and 80 V identified by grey relational analysis.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements and grey relational grade analysis validated the optimal parameter selection.
